illustration.description: Two-column infographic illustration on white graph paper. Left side: solid black silhouette of a tall, lean adult man standing with arms outstretched horizontally; below him, a slimmer black silhouette with long arms and legs; at the bottom, a grey-outlined anatomical line drawing of a human hand and wrist bones viewed from the back. Right side: solid black silhouette of a standing man with arms outstretched, a stockier, heavier-set black silhouette, and a grey-outlined anatomical line drawing of a hand and wrist bones. Flat vector style, crisp edges, pure black fills, minimal shading, clean white background.
